what_this_is: Stand-ins drawn from never-host utilities take the real hosts' places, states and first-crossing years; the specification in PREANALYSIS.md is run on each draw, read with the inference procedure named in `procedure`. Only never-host utilities' prices are read, one file per utility, through the access list.

procedure.label: the selected and validated procedure (step E)
procedure.range: 90% CR2 t range with Satterthwaite degrees of freedom (Pustejovsky and Tipton 2018, arXiv v2 Eq. 4, 7, 8, 11)
procedure.early_years_test: approximate Hotelling test on event years -6, -5 and -4 with CR2 (Eq. 10, 12, 13), failing at p below 0.10
procedure.told_from_zero: the 90% CR2 t range lies above zero

standard: docs/DECISIONS.md, D-38, committed before this was run.
not_in_the_simulation: future hosts as a second comparison group
each sub-experiment uses utilities observed in all ten of its years
utilities in Alaska and Hawaii, which have no degree-day series
gas_share_assumption: After the other controls, differences in outcomes are modeled as linear in the state's 2008 to 2010 gas share, with a slope free to differ by calendar year. A state's generation mix is a proxy for what a utility is exposed to; the adjustment does not establish that it measures any utility's own power supply (D-59 item 7).
ownership_assumption: municipal systems, public power districts and distribution cooperatives with no row in the ownership table are each taken as their own owner, from EIA's ownership class (D-58 rule 2.2)
